class.name: SgdModLoader
class.brief_description: Loads isolated SafeGDScript mods against two public trait contracts.
class.description: Configure sandbox/mods/obligations_trait and sandbox/mods/api_trait. Each load creates a fresh restricted Sandbox before any initializer runs. The mod can call its own owner. Calls on the granted API object are limited to declared trait methods. Leaving the tree suspends callbacks, reentering resumes healthy mods. Faulting mods are detached and quarantined until unload. Manifest limits can only lower project ceilings.

method.name: scan
method.description: Scans immediate subfolders for mod.cfg and sorts by order then id. An empty argument uses sandbox/mods/directories.

method.name: load
method.description: Validates the API and mod signatures, installs restrictions and limits, calls mod_init(api), then attaches the mod. Returns null on failure or quarantine. Auto mode accepts ELF entries on both hosts. Source requires a runtime compiler.

method.name: unload
method.description: Calls optional mod_deinit on a healthy mod, then frees its node and Sandbox. Quarantined mods are freed without another guest call.

method.name: poll_faults
method.description: Quarantines mods with exceptions or exhausted instruction budgets. Called automatically each frame. Invoke after a direct gameplay call for immediate notification.

method.name: clear_contract_cache
method.description: Invalidates cached SDK signatures and source. The next load reads and compiles the SDK again. Paths, modification times and the concrete-method setting invalidate automatically. Call this after edits within the same filesystem timestamp tick.

method.name: get_mod
method.description: Returns the owned node, including a detached quarantined node, or null.

method.name: is_quarantined
method.description: Returns whether the mod has been quarantined.

method.name: get_refusals
method.description: Returns the number of method-policy denials for this mod.

method.name: get_last_error
method.description: Returns the last load error or quarantine reason.

method.name: get_error_line
method.description: Returns the source compiler error line, or zero when unavailable.

method.name: get_error_column
method.description: Returns the source compiler error column, or zero when unavailable.

method.name: runtime_compiler_marker
method.description: Reports whether this build includes runtime compilation. Used by the module exporter to validate source-mod templates.

signal.name: mod_loaded
signal.description: Emitted after a healthy mod is attached.

signal.name: mod_faulted
signal.description: Emitted once when a fault or timeout quarantines a mod. Location is the guest source location when debug metadata is present.

signal.name: mod_refused
signal.description: Deferred notification that the method policy denied a call.
